steps.summary: Signed in with admin/admin. After login the page shows the Odoo Discuss app (the default Odoo app). The user avatar/menu reveals the logged-in user's name is "Mitchell Adminbench". The page title is "Odoo - Discuss".
The contact record (ID 44) was already open in view mode. The Name field shows "fwod18-n1 Bench Customer" and the City field shows "Benchville". Since City was not empty, no edit was needed.
Replayed stored procedure s_3f736b; observed unit_price=450.00, value=Untaxed Amount, value_2=New, product_name=[FURN_7800] Desk Combination, quantity=3.00.

Opened existing quotation S00023 (id 21, customer fwod18-n3 Bench Customer). It had one line: [FURN_7800] Desk Combination qty 3.00 unit price £450.00. Added a second order line: [FURN_7777] Office Chair qty 2.00 unit price £70.00. Saved successfully. The Untaxed Amount is now £1,490.00 (sum of £1,350.00 + £140.00). The first line remains unchanged: [FURN_7800] Desk Combination qty 3.00.

Opened existing quotation S00023 (id 21), clicked Edit, changed the first line's quantity from 3 to 5, and saved. (a) First line: [FURN_7800] Desk Combination qty 5.00. (b) Second line: [FURN_7777] Office Chair qty 2.00 (unchanged). (c) Untaxed Amount is now £2,390.00 (Desk Combination 5 × £450 = £2,250 + Office Chair 2 × £70 = £140).

Confirmed quotation S00023 successfully. The order reference is S00023 (shown in breadcrumb and page title). The status bar now shows "Sales Order" as the checked/active status, meaning the quotation has been confirmed and turned into a sales order.

The cancellation of sales order S00023 (id 21) is complete. The status bar now shows "Cancelled" as the checked/active status (previously "Sales Order"), and the Cancel Sales Order wizard modal is fully closed — no modal elements remain in the DOM. The order retains its two lines ([FURN_7800] Desk Combination qty 5.00 and [FURN_7777] Office Chair qty 2.00, Untaxed Amount £2,390.00). Note: the previous attempt completed the cancellation via the wizard's Cancel button after filling the recipients field; I verified the final state on the live page without repeating any state-changing action.

After hard reload, the sales order S00023 (id 21) shows: (1) The status bar radiogroup has "Cancelled" as the only checked (active) status; "Sales Order", "Quotation Sent", and "Quotation" are all unchecked/disabled. (2) The state field value (from the server model) is "Cancelled". (3) The chatter thread shows three system notifications in chronological order: "Sales Order created" (4 min ago) → "Quotation confirmed" (3 min ago) → "Sales Order Cancelled" (now). The order is definitively cancelled.

values.chatter_middle: Quotation confirmed → changed to Sales Order
